title: Sunlock
summary:
Sunlock is a restrictive spell. It creates a pair of handcuffs made up of amber energy rendering an ennemy unable to cast spells.
It is a favored spell of Lucas Casterwill.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Lucas used Sunlock to neutralize Sophie Casterwill when he and his team attacked the Huntik team in the Casterwill Library. Sophie was unable to use Boltflare but was eventually freed by Lok Lambert using the Willblade. Later, Lucas used the spell against Unnamed Suit 056 whilst rescuing Lok and Sophie. [Chasing Void]

During the battle with the Blood Spiral army at the Fortress of Iron Will, Lucas used the spell alongside Lane's Bristlebind spell to incapacitate a pair of Silent Soldiers. [The Spiral War]

Lucas used the spell alongside Kindlestrike against some Silent Soldiers during the final battle at the Blood Spiral Base. However he was then knocked out by Wind. [Lok and the Betrayer]
